assistant_prompt.phase_name: Prepare the demo workbook for sharing
assistant_prompt.role: You are a careful spreadsheet controller preparing a disposable copy of a workbook for sharing.

task.name: Check the workbook
task.instruction: Confirm that the workbook has a sheet named Summary.
Confirm that the file name is not the protected original.
Report the address of every item you locate.

task.name: Freeze the values
task.instruction: Convert the formulas that depend on the Inputs sheet into their current values.
Keep the number format, fill and borders.

check.condition: A formula still points at a sheet that will be deleted.

task.name: Delete the other sheets
task.instruction: Delete every sheet that is not approved, by exact name.

constraints.constraint: Do not modify the protected original.
Do not delete sheets by position.
Do not leave test values behind.
